rows.commentary: 5.2: Amanda-Jade Wellington tosses it up, and Olivia Porter drives firmly into the extra-cover region to rotate the strike for a single.
5.3: Courtney Webb does not score off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
5.4: Amanda-Jade Wellington drops it short, and Courtney Webb pulls it away into the deep mid-wicket turf for an easy run.
5.5: Olivia Porter does not score off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
5.6: Amanda-Jade Wellington slides it through, and Olivia Porter works it out toward sweeper cover to collect another single.
6.1: Olivia Porter does not score off Tahlia McGrath.
6.2: No run for Olivia Porter off Tahlia McGrath.
6.3: Tahlia McGrath steams in and bangs it into the pitch, allowing Olivia Porter to pull it down to deep mid-wicket for one.
6.4: Courtney Webb does not score off Tahlia McGrath.
6.5: Tahlia McGrath attacks the stumps, and Courtney Webb guides the ball away towards sweeper cover to pick up a single.
6.6: Tahlia McGrath strikes as Olivia Porter holes out to Maia Bouchier, departing for 12 after striking a boundary.
7.1: No run for Courtney Webb off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
7.2: Amanda-Jade Wellington tosses it up again, and Courtney Webb sweeps it deep into the mid-wicket pocket for a single.
7.3: No run for Sophie Molineux off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
7.4: Amanda-Jade Wellington tosses it up, Sophie Molineux works it firmly away into the deep mid-wicket pocket and trots through for a single.
7.5: Amanda-Jade Wellington fires it in, and Courtney Webb turns it securely toward deep mid-wicket for a comfortable run.
7.6: No run for Sophie Molineux off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
17.4: Amanda-Jade Wellington sees Sophie Molineux sweep powerfully away to the backward square leg boundary.
17.5: Dot ball from Amanda-Jade Wellington to Sophie Molineux.
17.6: No run for Sophie Molineux off Amanda-Jade Wellington.
18.1: Leg byes off Ella Wilson's delivery to Georgia Wareham, 2 runs in all.
18.2: No run for Georgia Wareham off Ella Wilson.
18.3: Ella Wilson watches Georgia Wareham fall short in a frantic run out executed by Maia Bouchier and Bridget Patterson after a brisk 27.
18.4: Wilson fires one in as Chloe Tryon pushes it toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
18.5: Wilson errs in length and Sophie Molineux dispatches it aggressively to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
18.6: Wilson finishes the over as Molineux works a single squarely off the wicket.
19.1: Wide from Megan Schutt to Sophie Molineux.
19.1: Megan Schutt is greeted by Sophie Molineux carving a boundary down to third man.
19.2: No run for Sophie Molineux off Megan Schutt.
19.3: Schutt keeps it tight while Molineux rotates the strike out to deep mid-wicket.
19.4: Schutt bangs it in, but Chloe Tryon ramps it brilliantly to the square third man fence.
19.5: Schutt closes out the sequence as Tryon scampers hard for a pair of runs toward deep mid-wicket.
19.6: Megan Schutt steams in for the final delivery and Chloe Tryon sweeps it away into the deep mid-wicket grass for a single.
10.6: No run for Tahlia McGrath off Georgia Wareham.
11.1: Vlaeminck delivers into the arc, and Wolvaardt dismisses it away to deep mid-wicket for four.
11.2: Vlaeminck bowls a wide to Laura Wolvaardt.
11.2: Vlaeminck offers width, pierced cleanly by Wolvaardt through deep extra cover to the boundary.
11.3: Vlaeminck keeps testing the length, worked securely by Wolvaardt toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
11.4: Vlaeminck targets the line, gently nudged by Tahlia McGrath into deep extra cover for one.
11.5: Vlaeminck pushes it through, collected calmly by Wolvaardt out at deep mid-wicket for a brace.
11.6: Vlaeminck bangs it full, driven straight down the ground by Wolvaardt for two more.
12.1: Hayley Matthews loops it up, worked away by Tahlia McGrath toward deep mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
12.2: Hayley Matthews drops it short, punished emphatically by Wolvaardt to deep mid-wicket for four.
12.3: Hayley Matthews floats it on a length, dabbed into the cover region by Wolvaardt for a single.
12.4: Hayley Matthews fires it in, flicked smoothly by Tahlia McGrath out to deep mid-wicket for one.
12.5: Hayley Matthews tosses it up, swept safely by Wolvaardt toward deep mid-wicket for two.
12.6: Hayley Matthews lands it on off, punched cleanly by Wolvaardt to extra cover for a quick single.
13.1: Deandra Dottin sends it down to Laura Wolvaardt, who works it away cleanly into the deep mid-wicket grass for a single.
13.2: Deandra Dottin fires a four to deep extra cover, Tahlia McGrath drives it over.
13.3: Deandra Dottin smashes a six to long‑on, Tahlia McGrath sends it over the boundary.
17.3: Tayla Vlaeminck steams in with pace, but Laura Wolvaardt swivels effortlessly to whip the ball away to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
17.4: Tayla Vlaeminck tests the batter's reach, and Laura Wolvaardt answers by slicing a sharp drive through deep extra cover for four.
17.5: Tayla Vlaeminck bangs it in short, only for Laura Wolvaardt to hook with utter disdain all the way over the deep mid-wicket ropes for six.
17.6: Laura Wolvaardt does not score off Vlaeminck.
18.1: Sophie Molineux loops one up, and Bridget Patterson drives on the up, threading the gap brilliantly to deep extra cover for four.
18.2: Sophie Molineux keeps it tight, allowing Bridget Patterson to simply nurdle the ball into the mid-wicket region for a single.
18.3: No run for Laura Wolvaardt off Sophie Molineux.
18.4: Sophie Molineux fires it in, and Laura Wolvaardt guides it smartly down towards fine leg to scamper back for three well-run runs.
18.5: Sophie Molineux induces a late deflection off the bat face, sending Bridget Patterson scampering across the turf for three runs down to third man.
18.6: Sophie Molineux finishes the over as Laura Wolvaardt works a neat placement into the deep mid-wicket pocket to pick up two runs.
19.1: Deandra Dottin steams in to deliver the first ball of the final over, and Bridget Patterson tucks it away into the depths of mid-wicket for a single.
19.2: Deandra Dottin sends it down to Laura Wolvaardt, who drives firmly out to long-on to scamper back for a sharp couple of runs.
19.3: Deandra Dottin charges in again to Laura Wolvaardt, who sweeps this hard into the deep mid-wicket pocket to hustle another comfortable brace.
19.4: Deandra Dottin strikes at the death, sending Laura Wolvaardt's off-stump cartwheeling after a magnificent 91 off 58 balls featuring eleven fours and a six.
19.5: Deandra Dottin delivers to Eleanor Larosa, who guides the ball deftly past the keeper down to the third-man boundary for four.
